issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 issue asking that SubscriptionStatus.notificationEvent.focus and additionalContext tell servers to include Reference.type for id-only notifications, narrowed by resolution to cases where the type is not specified in Reference.reference.
initial_application: Commit d6c1b2b51cceafb049633b0e25c1f08a0d0300d5 added the Reference.type SHOULD statement to the active SubscriptionStatus notification-type tables for focus and additionalContext.
additional_context: SubscriptionStatus is active in source/fhir.ini. The origin Zulip discussion confirms the id-only discoverability use case and PHI caveat. Later FHIR-50574 general Reference.type guidance clarifies that literal FHIR references duplicate type while Reference.identifier cases benefit from type, which is consistent with FHIR-34059's condition.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current SubscriptionStatus notes already convey the accepted Reference.type SHOULD guidance for both affected elements. The remaining duplicated word in the existing sentence is editorial only and does not change conformance expectations.
